passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.1
passages.text: Quam legis, a rapta Briseide littera venit,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.2
passages.text: Vix bene barbarica Graeca notata manu.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.3
passages.text: Quascumque adspicies, lacrimae fecere lituras;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.4
passages.text: Sed tamen et lacrimae pondera vocis habent.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.5
passages.text: Si mihi pauca queri de te dominoque viroque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.6
passages.text: Fas est, de domino pauca viroque querar.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.7
passages.text: Non, ego poscenti quod sum cito tradita regi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.8
passages.text: Culpa tua est — quamvis haec quoque culpa tua est;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.9
passages.text: Nam simul Eurybates me Talthybiusque vocarunt,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.10
passages.text: Eurybati data sum Talthybioque comes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.11
passages.text: Alter in alterius iactantes lumina vultum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.12
passages.text: Quaerebant taciti, noster ubi esset amor.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.13
passages.text: Differri potui; poenae mora grata fuisset.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.14
passages.text: Ei mihi! discedens oscula nulla dedi;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.15
passages.text: At lacrimas sine fine dedi rupique capillos —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.16
passages.text: Infelix iterum sum mihi visa capi!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.17
passages.text: Saepe ego decepto volui custode reverti,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.18
passages.text: Sed, me qui timidam prenderet, hostis erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.19
passages.text: Si progressa forem, caperer ne, nocte, timebam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.20
passages.text: Quamlibet ad Priami munus itura nurum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.21
passages.text: Sed data sim, quia danda fui — tot noctibus absum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.22
passages.text: Nec repetor; cessas, iraque lenta tua est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.23
passages.text: Ipse Menoetiades tum, cum tradebar, in aurem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.24
passages.text: 'Quid fles? hic parvo tempore,' dixit, 'eris.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.25
passages.text: Nec repetisse parum; pugnas ne reddar, Achille!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.26
passages.text: I nunc et cupidi nomen amantis habe!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.27
passages.text: Venerunt ad te Telamone et Amyntore nati —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.28
passages.text: Ille gradu propior sanguinis, ille comes —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.29
passages.text: Laertaque satus, per quos comitata redirem

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.30
passages.text: (auxerunt blandas grandia dona preces)

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.31
passages.text: Viginti fulvos operoso ex aere lebetas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.32
passages.text: Et tripodas septem pondere et arte pares;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.33
passages.text: Addita sunt illis auri bis quinque talenta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.34
passages.text: Bis sex adsueti vincere semper equi,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.35
passages.text: Quodque supervacuum est, forma praestante puellae

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.36
passages.text: Lesbides, eversa corpora capta domo,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.37
passages.text: Cumque tot his — sed non opus est tibi coniuge — coniunx

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.38
passages.text: Ex Agamemnoniis una puella tribus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.39
passages.text: Si tibi ab Atride pretio redimenda fuissem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.40
passages.text: Quae dare debueras, accipere illa negas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.41
passages.text: Qua merui culpa fieri tibi vilis, Achille?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.42
passages.text: Quo levis a nobis tam cito fugit amor?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.43
passages.text: An miseros tristis fortuna tenaciter urget,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.44
passages.text: Nec venit inceptis mollior hora malis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.45
passages.text: Diruta Marte tuo Lyrnesia moenia vidi —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.46
passages.text: Et fueram patriae pars ego magna meae;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.47
passages.text: Vidi consortes pariter generisque necisque

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.48
passages.text: Tres cecidisse, quibus, quae mihi, mater erat;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.49
passages.text: Vidi, quantus erat, fusum tellure cruenta

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.50
passages.text: Pectora iactantem sanguinolenta virum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.51
passages.text: Tot tamen amissis te conpensavimus unum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.52
passages.text: Tu dominus, tu vir, tu mihi frater eras.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.53
passages.text: Tu mihi, iuratus per numina matris aquosae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.54
passages.text: Utile dicebas ipse fuisse capi —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.55
passages.text: Scilicet ut, quamvis veniam dotata, repellas

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.56
passages.text: Et mecum fugias quae tibi dantur opes!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.57
passages.text: Quin etiam fama est, cum crastina fulserit Eos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.58
passages.text: Te dare nubiferis lintea velle Notis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.59
passages.text: Quod scelus ut pavidas miserae mihi contigit aures,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.60
passages.text: Sanguinis atque animi pectus inane fuit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.61
passages.text: Ibis et — o miseram! — cui me, violente, relinquis?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.62
passages.text: Quis mihi desertae mite levamen erit?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.63
passages.text: Devorer ante, precor, subito telluris hiatu

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.64
passages.text: Aut rutilo missi fulminis igne cremer,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.65
passages.text: Quam sine me Pthiis canescant aequora remis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.66
passages.text: Et videam puppes ire relicta tuas!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.67
passages.text: Si tibi iam reditusque placent patriique Penates,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.68
passages.text: Non ego sum classi sarcina magna tuae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.69
passages.text: Victorem captiva sequar, non nupta maritum;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.70
passages.text: Est mihi, quae lanas molliat, apta manus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.71
passages.text: Inter Achaeiadas longe pulcherrima matres

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.72
passages.text: In thalamos coniunx ibit eatque tuos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.73
passages.text: Digna nurus socero, Iovis Aeginaeque nepote,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.74
passages.text: Cuique senex Nereus prosocer esse velit.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.75
passages.text: Nos humiles famulaeque tuae data pensa trahemus,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.76
passages.text: Et minuent plenas stamina nostra colos.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.77
passages.text: Exagitet ne me tantum tua, deprecor, uxor —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.78
passages.text: Quae mihi nescio quo non erit aequa modo —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.79
passages.text: Neve meos coram scindi patiare capillos

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.80
passages.text: Et leviter dicas: 'haec quoque nostra fuit.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.81
passages.text: Vel patiare licet, dum ne contempta relinquar —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.82
passages.text: Hic mihi vae! miserae concutit ossa metus.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.83
passages.text: Quid tamen expectas? Agamemnona paenitet irae,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.84
passages.text: Et iacet ante tuos Graecia maesta pedes.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.85
passages.text: Vince animos iramque tuam, qui cetera vincis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.86
passages.text: Quid lacerat Danaas inpiger Hector opes?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.87
passages.text: Arma cape, Aeacide, sed me tamen ante recepta,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.88
passages.text: Et preme turbatos Marte favente viros!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.89
passages.text: Propter me mota est, propter me desinat ira,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.90
passages.text: Simque ego tristitiae causa modusque tuae.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.91
passages.text: Nec tibi turpe puta precibus succumbere nostris;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.92
passages.text: Coniugis Oenides versus in arma prece est.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.93
passages.text: Res audita mihi, nota est tibi. fratribus orba

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.94
passages.text: Devovit nati spemque caputque parens.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.95
passages.text: Bellum erat; ille ferox positis secessit ab armis

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.96
passages.text: Et patriae rigida mente negavit opem.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.97
passages.text: Sola virum coniunx flexit. felicior illa!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.98
passages.text: At mea pro nullo pondere verba cadunt.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.99
passages.text: Nec tamen indignor nec me pro coniuge gessi

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.100
passages.text: Saepius in domini serva vocata torum.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.101
passages.text: Me quaedam, memini, dominam captiva vocabat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.102
passages.text: 'Servitio,' dixi, 'nominis addis onus.'

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.103
passages.text: Per tamen ossa viri subito male tecta sepulcro,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.104
passages.text: Semper iudiciis ossa verenda meis;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.105
passages.text: Perque trium fortes animas, mea numina, fratrum,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.106
passages.text: Qui bene pro patria cum patriaque iacent;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.107
passages.text: Perque tuum nostrumque caput, quae iunximus una,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.108
passages.text: Perque tuos enses, cognita tela meis —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.109
passages.text: Nulla Mycenaeum sociasse cubilia mecum

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.110
passages.text: Iuro; fallentem deseruisse velis!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.111
passages.text: Si tibi nunc dicam, fortissime: 'tu quoque iura

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.112
passages.text: Nulla tibi sine me gaudia capta!' neges.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.113
passages.text: At Danai maerere putant — tibi plectra moventur,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.114
passages.text: Te tenet in tepido mollis amica sinu!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.115
passages.text: Et quisquam quaerit, quare pugnare recuses?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.116
passages.text: Pugna nocet, citharae voxque Venusque iuvant.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.117
passages.text: Tutius est iacuisse toro, tenuisse puellam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.118
passages.text: Threiciam digitis increpuisse lyram,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.119
passages.text: Quam manibus clipeos et acutae cuspidis hastam,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.120
passages.text: Et galeam pressa sustinuisse coma.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.121
passages.text: Sed tibi pro tutis insignia facta placebant,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.122
passages.text: Partaque bellando gloria dulcis erat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.123
passages.text: An tantum dum me caperes, fera bella probabas,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.124
passages.text: Cumque mea patria laus tua victa iacet?

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.125
passages.text: Di melius! validoque, precor, vibrata lacerto

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.126
passages.text: Transeat Hectoreum Pelias hasta latus!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.127
passages.text: Mittite me, Danai! dominum legata rogabo

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.128
passages.text: Multaque mandatis oscula mixta feram.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.129
passages.text: Plus ego quam Phoenix, plus quam facundus Ulixes,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.130
passages.text: Plus ego quam Teucri, credite, frater agam.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.131
passages.text: Est aliquid collum solitis tetigisse lacertis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.132
passages.text: Praesentisque oculos admonuisse sui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.133
passages.text: Sis licet inmitis matrisque ferocior undis,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.134
passages.text: Ut taceam, lacrimis conminuere meis.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.135
passages.text: Nunc quoque — sic omnes Peleus pater inpleat annos,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.136
passages.text: Sic eat auspiciis Pyrrhus ad arma tuis! —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.137
passages.text: Respice sollicitam Briseida, fortis Achille,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.138
passages.text: Nec miseram lenta ferreus ure mora!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.139
passages.text: Aut, si versus amor tuus est in taedia nostri,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.140
passages.text: Quam sine te cogis vivere, coge mori!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.141
passages.text: Utque facis, coges. abiit corpusque colorque;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.142
passages.text: Sustinet hoc animae spes tamen una tui.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.143
passages.text: Qua si destituor, repetam fratresque virumque —

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.144
passages.text: Nec tibi magnificum femina iussa mori.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.145
passages.text: Cur autem iubeas? stricto pete corpora ferro;

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.146
passages.text: Est mihi qui fosso pectore sanguis eat.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.147
passages.text: Me petat ille tuus, qui, si dea passa fuisset,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.148
passages.text: Ensis in Atridae pectus iturus erat!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.149
passages.text: A, potius serves nostram, tua munera, vitam!

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.150
passages.text: Quod dederas hosti victor, amica rogo.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.151
passages.text: Perdere quos melius possis, Neptunia praebent

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.152
passages.text: Pergama; materiam caedis ab hoste pete.

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.153
passages.text: Me modo, sive paras inpellere remige classem,

passages.label: Ov. Her. 3.154
passages.text: Sive manes, domini iure venire iube!
